headline: Docs, audit reports, and GitHub org surfaced; no Solana program IDs discovered across 6 fetches — DeFiPunkd read-API does not support Solana chain.
short_headline: No program IDs found — Solana chain

findings.text: D1: Solana block explorers (solscan.io, solana.fm) were not fetchable via allowed URL patterns; one search query for Loopscale program IDs on Solana returned only generic Solana docs and solana.fm homepage — zero Loopscale-tagged program addresses surfaced.

D2: docs.loopscale.com fetched successfully; llms.txt index lists ~50 doc pages including /resources/audits, /resources/risks-and-security, /resources/asset-parameters — no dedicated 'Deployed Contracts' / 'Addresses' page was present in the index. The docs site is the canonical docs source but does not publish program IDs.

D3: OShield audit report fetched from github.com/oshieldio/Publications at commit main. Report reveals source repo is github.com/bridgesplit/bridgesplit-program-library (audit start commit e5a73897c363d3a1a55113de6abdec5784931f01). Scope section lists file paths (bridgesplit-program-library/programs/loopscale/...) but no deployed on-chain program IDs. Audits page at docs.loopscale.com lists 8 audits: OShield (Feb 2025), sec3 (May 2025), Adevar Labs (July 2025, Nov 2025, Dec 2025, Mar 2026 x2, May 2026), Highland Security (July 2025).

D4: GitHub org LoopscaleLabs was surfaced via search — repos visible include loopscale-pricing-adapters, audits, flash-sdk-rust, DefiLlama-Adapters, squads-v4, raydium-clmm, mercurial-dynamic-amm-sdk, amm-sdk. Direct fetch of github.com/LoopscaleLabs was rejected by the URL allowlist (not in prior fetch results). The audit source repo github.com/bridgesplit/bridgesplit-program-library was referenced in the OShield report but was not directly fetchable this run. No deployment artifacts (run-latest.json, deployments.json, addresses.json) were retrieved.

D5: Protocol is Solana-only (single chain). DeFiPunkd read-API does not support Solana (supported chainIds are EVM only: 1, 10, 56, 130, 137, 324, 8453, 42161, 43114, 59144, 81457, 534352, 11155111). No Solana-chain addresses were surfaced from any fetched source.
D6: No factory addresses discovered — prerequisite (D1/D4 program IDs) not met. Not applicable this run.
D7: No addresses classified — none were discovered with sufficient on-chain evidence.

D8: No addresses were placed in admin_addresses[] because no address passed the ratchet-integrity check (all require ≥1 fetched URL containing the address). The squads-v4 repo fork in LoopscaleLabs suggests Squads multisig may be used for upgrade authority, but no specific multisig address was found.

rationale.verdict: Discovery is incomplete: 6 fetches of website (blocked), OShield audit (no program IDs), docs index, docs audits page, docs risks page, and a search yielded protocol description and audit metadata but zero deployed Solana program IDs. DeFiPunkd's read API lacks Solana support, and Solana block explorers were not in the fetch allowlist for this run. The next run should prioritize fetching github.com/LoopscaleLabs/audits, github.com/bridgesplit/bridgesplit-program-library, solscan.io search for 'Loopscale', and docs.loopscale.com/resources/asset-parameters which may contain oracle/program addresses.

evidence.shows: OShield audit report for Loopscale V1 (Jan–Feb 2025). Identifies source repo as github.com/bridgesplit/bridgesplit-program-library at commit e5a73897c363d3a1a55113de6abdec5784931f01. No deployed program IDs listed. Found 3 critical, 1 high, 1 medium, 2 informational findings — all resolved. Protocol described as Solana-based order-book lending with Pyth/Switchboard oracles, Orca/Meteora integrations.
Canonical docs index for docs.loopscale.com. Lists ~50 pages. No 'deployed contracts' or 'addresses' page present. References /resources/audits and /resources/risks-and-security pages.

Loopscale audits and bug bounty page. Lists 8 audits: OShield (Feb 25, 2025, Loopscale V1, private), sec3 (May 19, 2025, Loopscale V1, private), Adevar Labs (July 31 2025; Nov 5 2025; Dec 18 2025; Mar 18 2026; Mar 27 2026; May 7 2026), Highland Security (July 11 2025). Bug bounty up to $250k critical, contact security@loopscale.com.
Protocol risk disclosure. References /resources/asset-parameters for oracle list. States all contracts have been audited and are undergoing additional audits. No program IDs disclosed.

Loopscale docs homepage confirming protocol is a modular, order book-based lending protocol on Solana supporting overcollateralized borrowing/lending, fixed-rate fixed-duration loans, staked tokens, LP positions, and RWA collateral. App at app.loopscale.com.

protocol_metadata.about: Loopscale is a modular, order book-based lending protocol on Solana enabling fixed-rate, fixed-duration overcollateralized loans through direct matching between lenders and borrowers. Users can borrow or lend across a wide range of digital assets including SPL tokens, staked SOL, Orca/Raydium CLMM LP positions, and tokenized real-world assets. The protocol replaces pooled liquidity and algorithmic rates with a credit order book, providing lend-rate-equals-borrow-rate capital efficiency and isolated risk per market. Loopscale Vaults allow passive lenders to deposit into curated strategies managed by third-party curators, with time-locked parameter changes for depositor protection.
